banner.title: matter-server
banner.tagline: Hosts the Python Matter controller that Home Assistant talks to, on a fixed IoT address and a WebSocket on port 5580.

explainer.title: A root controller on the IoT VLAN, backed up daily

steps.title: Address
steps.text: Multus attaches net1 on multus-iot at a fixed 10.40.0.101/22, with a pinned MAC.
steps.scene: two network switches linked by a glowing cable

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: python-matter-server listens on WebSocket port 5580 and advertises matter.${SECRET_DOMAIN}. The envoy-internal route carries it to Home Assistant.
steps.scene: a plug sending light along a glowing wire

steps.title: Root
steps.text: The container runs as UID and GID 0 with supplemental group 34. The security context says the controller needs root.
steps.scene: a hardened shield over a server core

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the matter-server claim to R2 each day. The mover runs as UID 0, which needs privileged movers.
steps.scene: snapshot cards flowing into a cloud bucket
